OSS Document Scanner contour detector
=====================================

Upstream copyright: Copyright (c) 2022 Martin Guillon
Upstream license: MIT
Upstream source: https://github.com/ossappscollective/OSS-DocumentScanner
Pinned revision: 444bd810e77c571d66d2eecb3e13371e722ee538

Local modifications: OpenScaner translated the checked TypeScript/OpenCV
document-contour pipeline and its application defaults into the isolated
Python CPU adapter in openscaner.adapters.oss_contour. The port adds only
structured diagnostics and the common adapter result contract around that
algorithm.

The verbatim upstream MIT license, including its copyright and warranty
text, is packaged at licenses/MIT-OSS-DocumentScanner.txt.
